stem.text: The diagram shows the apparatus used to find the relative molecular mass of a volatile liquid.
When 0.10 g of a volatile liquid is injected into the syringe, all of the volatile liquid evaporates and the volume increases by 85 cm$^{3}$.
The heater maintains a temperature of 400 K and the experiment is carried out at a pressure of 101 300 Pa.

stem.alt: Apparatus: a volatile liquid is injected into a syringe inside a heated box; a thermometer runs alongside the syringe and a heater is below it

stem.text: If the vapour of the volatile liquid behaves as an ideal gas, which expression can be used to calculate the relative molecular mass of the liquid?
